Transaction account lifecycle, access control, and account field update helpers.

# Purpose
`fd_txn_account.c` implements the transaction account object used during account processing. It provides constructors and destructors for `fd_txn_account_t`, plus join and leave functions that attach the object to account metadata and data stored in workspace memory. The code validates pointers, alignment, and a magic value before it sets up internal fields such as the public key, metadata pointer, data pointer, and mutability state. It also includes factory helpers that build a transaction account from `funk` and `accdb` state for read-only and mutable access.

The file also defines the main account access API used by transaction execution. It provides getters for owner, metadata, data, lamports, executable state, and rent epoch, and setters for mutable accounts that update owner, lamports, data, slot, and executable flags. It includes checked lamport add and subtract operations, resize logic for account data, and simple borrow and release functions that control exclusive write access. The file also contains conversion to `fd_solana_account_meta_t`, which exposes account state in the Solana format used by other parts of the system.
